description: Gameplay footage from a dim flooded cave basin with rock formations, kelp and cave-wall textures. Tux swims around the basin, collects some of the coins floating there and interacts with objects in it; twice during the clip a group of new coins appears, and the clip follows the basin until the end, including a stretch where Tux swims up out of the basin and comes back down.
reproduces: https://github.com/SuperTux/supertux/issues/3729 (coins from a coin-burst block in Deep Dive 'n' Chill ignoring water), plus five injected burst/landing/pickup/persistence defects; recorded on the task's buggy build (base commit + environment/bugs/*.patch)
scenario: data/levels/world1/deep_dive_chill.stl with its geometry, tiles, fish and placed coins unchanged; the level's first coin-explosion block (tile 2948 at x=864, y=2144, the exact repro from the issue) plus one extra coin-explosion bonus block added in the same basin at x=1152, y=2144 so that a second burst can be shown. Captured headless (Xvfb + SDL renderer + ffmpeg x11grab, 1280x800, 30 fps) from the buggy build; Tux is placed in the block's basin at the start of the clip and driven by the scripting controller (collects some of the placed coins, swim-boosts into the first block at ~0:07, sweeps the basin floor through the released coins, swim-boosts into the second block at ~0:17, swims up out of the basin at ~0:22, comes back down at ~0:32 and sweeps the floor again). Tux is flagged intentionally-safe for the run so a chasing fish cannot end it; this has no visible effect. The level-intro card is cut.
